verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into an available Counter Strike or let fights run long after level 6 when Relentless Assault snowballs; you win if you poke with Mourning Mist, wall with Dark Procession, and only commit Last Rites once his Q and E are both down.

brief.thesis: This looks even on paper but actually tilts to Jax (44.7% Yorick win rate over 76 games) because his kit punishes exactly the melee auto-attack trading your Q (Last Rites) needs to dig graves. Counter Strike dodges incoming basic attacks and then stuns and damages everyone around him, turning a greedy Last Rites proc into a lost trade, while Relentless Assault gives him free attack speed scaling with bonus damage every third hit in any fight that runs long from level 6 onward. You have to win this lane from range with Mourning Mist and wall control, not with extended melee commitment.

theirWindow.when: Jax has Q and E up
theirWindow.what: He can leap in with Leap Strike, bait an auto-attack into Counter Strike's dodge-and-stun, and punish any extended trade. Back off and poke with Mourning Mist instead of auto-trading.

yourWindow.when: Jax has used both Q and E
yourWindow.what: He has no engage, no stun, and no escape left. Step in with Last Rites and auto-attacks to secure the trade and dig a grave.

start.why: Highest win-rate start into Jax (45.5% over 44 games); the extra sustain lets you poke-and-heal with Last Rites instead of being forced into a melee trade he wants.

boots.why: Jax's damage is entirely auto-attack based between Empower and Relentless Assault; flat physical damage reduction blunts both his empowered strikes and his attack-speed-stacked ultimate.

core.why: Core item on the highest measured win-rate path (75% over 4 games); the proc gives you the stats and mobility to catch up after a poke-only early game.
Cooldown reduction accelerates Last Rites and Mourning Mist uptime, letting you poke more often per Jax engage window.
Bonus health and damage reduction at low health keeps you alive through a Counter Strike stun-and-damage sequence or an extended Relentless Assault fight.

situational.when: jax or his team stack armor and you need the shred to keep trading
you're ahead and want to split-push behind Dark Procession walls
you need more burst to punish Jax the moment his Q and E are both down

runes.keystoneWhy: Higher pick rate (21.9%) than the Conqueror page, and the sustain fits a lane where you're poking from range rather than committing to the extended autos Jax's kit is built to win. Master-tier Yorick players instead run Conqueror (488 games) if they're confident winning extended skirmishes rather than playing the poke-and-wall game.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite has the best measured win rate (52.8%) and punishes the short kill windows right after you've baited out his Q and E. Exhaust + Flash (44%) is the pick if you'd rather directly cut his attack speed and damage during a Relentless Assault fight than rely on a kill secure.

playing.title: Track Counter Strike before trading
playing.detail: Counter Strike (300 range, 18/16/14/12/10s CD) dodges your incoming basic attacks, then stuns and damages everyone around him. Never commit Last Rites autos into it; only trade once you've seen it go on cooldown.

playing.title: Poke from Mourning Mist range
playing.detail: E (700 range) outranges Counter Strike (300 range) and lets you apply the armor shred, damage, and slow before he can close distance on his own terms.

playing.title: Bait out his Q and E
playing.detail: Let him commit Leap Strike to close and Counter Strike to punish or escape, then commit Last Rites and auto-attacks while both are down.

playing.title: Cap trade length after level 6
playing.detail: Relentless Assault has no cooldown and grants attack speed with bonus damage on every third hit. Any fight that runs long past a few exchanges increasingly favors him, so disengage early rather than standing in it.

playing.title: Wall engages with Dark Procession
playing.detail: W (600 range) drops a destructible wall that blocks enemy movement. Use it to cut off his Leap Strike angle or block his exit after he's burned Counter Strike.

playing.title: Save Eulogy of the Isles for sieges
playing.detail: R summons the Maiden and raises Walkers from dead enemies around a 600 range. It's a split-push and tower-break tool, not a duel cooldown, so don't burn it trying to win a 1v1.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune pages, boots, starting items, and summoner spells are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the cooldown and timing reads and the matchup verdict are my own analysis of the ability text, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: If Jax closes in with (Q) to use his (E), use [E] to retreat. Try to fight Jax when he has both (Q) and (E) on cooldown. He will use (Q) to close in, deal damage, and (Q) again to retreat. Use [E] and [P] to poke while waiting for (E) and (Q) to be on cooldown to kill him.
